name: Phreesia (PHR)
teaser: Phreesia earned $122.0 million of adjusted EBITDA over the last twelve months, but after $59.4 million of stock pay and equipment leases only $2.3 million reached owners. At $10.81 the stock trades at my $10.88 Base, which already assumes the cost cuts work, so the call is Hold, do not add.
llms: US healthcare IT platform that runs patient check-in software at roughly one in six US visits, with payment processing and patient financing (AccessOne, acquired November 2025) and point-of-care pharmaceutical marketing. Valued on enterprise value as a multiple of next twelve months' adjusted EBITDA minus stock-based compensation (9.0x on $81.9 million), cross-checked with a ten-year owner cash flow model after stock compensation. Trailing adjusted EBITDA was $122.0 million, but after $59.4 million of stock compensation and equipment lease principal only $2.3 million of free cash flow reached owners; the price already assumes stock compensation falls to about $50 million and the margin after it rises 3.5 points. Bear $7.07, Base $10.88, Bull $14.57. Verdict HOLD at $10.81 (holders hold, do not add; new money watchlist), required margin of safety 60%, maximum buy price $4.35.
